available.quote: The Department may, in its discretion, license as a podiatric physician without examination on payment of the required fee, an applicant who is a podiatric physician license under the laws of another state or territory, or of another country, if the requirements for licensure of podiatric physicians in the state or territory or country in which the applicant was licensed were, at the date of his or her licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements in force in this State

requirements.value: Licensure by endorsement without examination if requirements in the applicant's prior jurisdiction were substantially equivalent to Illinois requirements at the time of licensure. Application must be completed within 3 years.
requirements.quote: if the requirements for licensure of podiatric physicians in the state or territory or country in which the applicant was licensed were, at the date of his or her licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements in force in this State on that date or on the date licensure is sought under this Section.

exists.quote: The Secretary shall appoint a Podiatric Medical Licensing Board as follows: 5 members must be actively engaged in the practice of podiatric medicine in this State

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who practices, offers to practice, attempts to practice, or holds oneself out to practice podiatry without being licensed under this Act shall, in addition to any other penalty provided by law, pay a civil penalty to the Department

title_protection.quote: for any person to diagnose the ailments of, or to treat in any manner the human foot by medical, physical or surgical methods, or to use the title "podiatric physician" or "podiatrist" or any words or letters which indicate or tend to indicate to the public that the person so treating or so holding himself or herself out is a podiatric physician.

scope_protection.quote: No person, except as provided in Section 3 of this Act, shall provide any type of diagnostic and therapeutic medical care services of the human foot unless under the supervision of a licensed podiatric physician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violations of this Act or of the rules adopted under this Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violations of this Act, or of the rules adopted under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or of a misdemeanor involving dishonesty, or a crime directly related to the practice of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction by plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or sentencing, including, but not limited to, convictions, preceding sentences of supervision, conditional discharge, or first offender probation, under the laws of any jurisdiction of the United States that is (i) a felony or (ii) a misdemeanor, an essential element of which is dishonesty, or that is directly related to the practice of the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any misrepresentation for the purpose of obtaining a license, or violating advertising provisions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any misrepresentation for the purpose of obtaining licenses, or violating any provision of this Act or the rules promulgated thereunder pertaining to advertising.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross or repeated malpractice or negligence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross or repeated malpractice or negligence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of this Act or rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of this Act or rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within 30 days to provide information in response to a written request by the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, within 30 days, to provide information in response to a written request made by the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use of alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or other chemical agent resulting in inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use of alcohol, narcotics, stimulants or other chemical agent or drug that results in the inability to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable judgment, skill or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another U.S. jurisdiction on substantially equivalent grounds.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another United States jurisdiction if at least one of the grounds for the discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those set forth in this Section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the prohibition against fee splitting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the prohibition against fee splitting in Section 24.2 of this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the terms of probation after license placed on probationary status.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Board that the licensee, after having his or her license placed on probationary status, has violated the terms of probation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in his or her practice, including but not limited to false records filed with state agencies or departments.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report suspected child abuse or neglect as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected child abuse or neglect as required by the Abused and Neglected Child Report Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical illness, mental illness, or other impairment resulting in inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical illness, mental illness, or other impairment, including, but not limited to, deterioration through the aging process, or loss of motor skill that results in the inability to practice the profession with reasonable judgment, skill or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicitation of professional services other than permitted advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicitation of professional services other than permitted advertising.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holding oneself out to treat human ailments under any name other than one's own, or impersonating another physician.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Holding oneself out to treat human ailments under any name other than his or her own, or the impersonation of any other physician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other action taken with respect to a podiatric license in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation or suspension or other action taken with respect to a podiatric medical license in another jurisdiction that would constitute disciplinary action under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promotion of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances or goods in a manner that exploits the patient for financial gain.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances or goods provided for a patient in such manner as to exploit the patient for financial gain of the podiatric physician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross, willful, and continued overcharging for professional services including filing false statements for collection of fees.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross, willful, and continued overcharging for professional services including filing false statements for collection of fees for those services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report of child abuse or neglect with clear and convincing proof.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report by the Department of Children and Family Services under the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act, and upon proof by clear and convincing evidence that the licensee has caused a child to be an abused child or neglected child

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing false records or reports to support claims against the medical assistance program.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in the practice of podiatric medicine, including, but not limited to, false records to support claims against the medical assistance program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct including sexual abuse, sexual misconduct, or sexual exploitation related to the licensee's practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct in the commission of any act including, sexual abuse, sexual misconduct, or sexual exploitation, related to the licensee's practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the Health Care Worker Self-Referral Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the Health Care Worker Self-Referral Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report adverse final action taken by another licensing jurisdiction, peer review body, health care institution, etc.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report to the Department any adverse final action taken against him or her by another licensing jurisdiction of the United States or any foreign state or country, any peer review body, any health care institution, any professional society or association, any governmental agency, any law enforcement agency, or any court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report suspected abuse, neglect, financial exploitation, or self-neglect of an eligible adult.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected abuse, neglect, financial exploitation, or self-neglect of an eligible adult as defined in and required by the Adult Protective Services Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report of elder abuse with clear and convincing proof.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report by the Department on Aging under the Adult Protective Services Act, and upon proof by clear and convincing evidence that the licensee has caused an eligible adult to be abused, neglected, or financially exploited

definition_quote.value: "Podiatric medicine" or "podiatry" means: (1) the diagnosis, medical, physical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, including amputations as defined in this Section; (2) the provision of topical and local anesthesia and moderate and deep sedation, as defined by Department rule adopted under the Medical Practice Act of 1987; and (3) vaccination of patients 18 years of age and older in accordance with Section 20.6 upon completion of appropriate training.
definition_quote.quote: "Podiatric medicine" or "podiatry" means: (1) the diagnosis, medical, physical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, including amputations as defined in this Section; (2) the provision of topical and local anesthesia and moderate and deep sedation, as defined by Department rule adopted under the Medical Practice Act of 1987; and (3) vaccination of patients 18 years of age and older in accordance with Section 20.6 upon completion of appropriate training.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, medical, physical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot

drug_authority.value: topical and local anesthesia and moderate and deep sedation, as defined by Department rule adopted under the Medical Practice Act of 1987
drug_authority.quote: the provision of topical and local anesthesia and moderate and deep sedation, as defined by Department rule adopted under the Medical Practice Act of 1987

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: "Human foot" means the ankle and soft tissue which insert into the foot as well as the foot.

amputation_authorized.quote: "Amputations" means amputations of the human foot, in whole or in part, that are limited to 10 centimeters proximal to the tibial talar articulation.

anesthesia_authority.quote: the provision of topical and local anesthesia and moderate and deep sedation, as defined by Department rule adopted under the Medical Practice Act of 1987

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: "Human foot" means the ankle and soft tissue which insert into the foot as well as the foot.

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: Persons suitably trained and qualified may render, only under the direction of a podiatric physician licensed under this Act, such patient tests and services as diagnostic imaging procedures, laboratory studies and other appropriate patient services connected with comprehensive foot care

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: Persons suitably trained and qualified may render, only under the direction of a podiatric physician licensed under this Act, such patient tests and services as diagnostic imaging procedures, laboratory studies and other appropriate patient services

vaccination_authority.quote: A podiatric physician may provide vaccinations to patients 18 years of age and older upon completion of appropriate training.

advanced_practice_nurse_collaboration_au.quote: A podiatric physician in active clinical practice may collaborate with an advanced practice registered nurse in accordance with the requirements of the Nurse Practice Act.
